main_text.l: sparatis. Non ita tractandos esse homi-nes, ac si non essent disimiles piscibus a-lijsue bestijs.v.14. à nocendi libidine & ἐπιχαιρεκακίᾳ[?] Chaldaeorum.v.15. à sacrile-ga eorudem persuasione de suis uiribus, quibus solis successus & uictorias acce-ptas ferant.v.16. à perpetuis Chaldaeorū molitionibus ad opprimendas & sub ser-uitutis iugum mittendas alias atq; alias gentes.v.17.
Hæcubi ad rei indignitatem tum indi-eandam, tum amplificandam, Habacuc magno zelo dixisset,

versu 1. modestè responsionem à Iehou-ah petit, & attentè eandem exspectat. Neque uero obscurè fatetur, se, ut alijs quoque de hisce iudiciorum diuinorum causis & circumstantijs interrogantibus satisfacere possit, oraculum diuinum religiosè expetere.

IIII. Respodet iterum Iehouah Deus noster: ac ubi seriam attentionem requi-siuisset,v.2. & certò complendum uaticinium testatus esset,v.3. subiungit bipartitā propositione, de Iniustis breui tempore se-se attollentib. & floretibus, & de Iustis fi-

page.notes: Long s is printed as f throughout and has been written as a plain s. The Greek word ἐπιχαιρεκακίᾳ is uncertain in its final letters. "Respodet" may have a superscript mark that I could not confirm. The "de" at the foot is a catchword, not text. The "Caput 2." line is in italic and centred, and I treated it as a chapter heading.
